description: Routing corpus for service/router.js preRoute (assistant v2 P1, dev-fcef). 'transcript' rows are the user turns of the 2026-10-16 sessions in the isolated assistant home (verbatim; docs/development/assistant-transcript-review-2026-10-16.md), 'requirement' rows the user's v2 requirement examples (proposal 2026-10-16 §5), 'ru' rows Russian equivalents. expect = the model the pre-router must pick; category is asserted when given.
